Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1. Hello Pastors, 
Many thanks for your program I'd like to know. 
My question is from Galatians 5 :23.
KJV Galatians 5:23
23 Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
Since there is no law against fruit of the spirit, how do we establish one has to keep Sabbath. Many thanks in advance. 
.
2.What is the difference between a Pastor and a church Elder.Is their ordination different.Can we clarify a Pastor as an Elder. What is the sea of glass of the book of Revelation Chapter 4 verse 6 and
Revelation 15 verse 2 .Will there a baptism at the sea of glass .
.
.
